description:
Move active window or app between virtual desktops using hotkeys

Windows 10 and 11 let you switch between virtual desktops using Ctrl+Win+Arrow, but they lack a built-in shortcut to move the currently active window to another desktop. This utility fills that gap by allowing you to move your active window or app to the next or previous virtual desktop on Windows 10 / 11 with a single keyboard shortcut - a feature Microsoft should have included long ago.
Added
- Desktop cycling: lets you switch from the last virtual desktop to the first, and vice versa (off by default).
- Desktop name display when switching desktops (on by default on Windows 10, off on Windows 11).
- Watchdog task that restarts the utility after unlock, user switch or resume from sleep/hibernation.
- More reliable hotkeys: keyboard hook is restored after resume/unlock, automatic reload after an Explorer restart.
- Debug logging: logs the keystrokes used, making troubleshooting easier.

Changed
- Holding a hotkey now performs one action per key press (v1.3 auto-repeated).
- Autostart tasks reworked; the default Windows task limitations no longer apply.
- Settings are stored in %AppData%\MoveWindowBetweenDesktops\settings.ini.
- Improved error messages.

Fixed
- Taskbar buttons flashing / windows appearing on the wrong desktop in the taskbar when switching with Ctrl + Alt + Arrow.
- Switching desktops while the Start menu or Action Center is open.
- Error when a hotkey was pressed while no window was active.
